notes: Gochara: transits are judged from the natal Moon's sign (sloka 1). Favourable houses (sloka 2) are blocked when another planet transits the matching vedha house (slokas 3-8). A planet in its own or exalted sign does little harm in a bad house; one in debilitation or an enemy's sign loses its good effect (slokas 31-32). Signs with more benefic Ashtakavarga bindus give good results even in difficult houses (sloka 41). Clauses about disease and death are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

skipped.reason: Moon's transits change every 2.5 days; too short-lived for a report.
Rahu in the 8th: danger to life, excluded by policy.
Which decanate of a sign a planet acts in: a timing refinement, not applied.
Nakshatra vedha (Sarvatobhadra chakra) and star-limb tables: mostly danger to life, excluded.

rules.note: Sloka 2 names only the favourable houses for Rahu and Ketu; sloka 24 gives house-by-house results for Rahu only.

rules.text: Ketu transiting the 11th house from the natal Moon: good results (Ketu, like the Sun, is favourable in the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th from the Moon).
